column1: # PROME/state/ORCH_LOG.tsv — authoritative record of orchestrated desk touches (two-tier model, Will-ruled 2026-08-23; single home = ORCHESTRATION_PLAYBOOK §Two-tier). One row per touch (spawn = touch 1; each re-ping increments). Feeds the 8/28 doorbell-soak review; standing post-8/28 reader = fleet_triage when built. Columns: date · desk · tier (subagent|window) · touch · trigger (what prompted the ping) · drained (inbox items integrated, N or n/a) · delivered (artifact + commit, or IN-FLIGHT) · zero_capital (OK = $0 moved, no thresholds, gated items returned to PROME) · notes
